items.title: Direct sums and products in the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the derived category of a Grothendieck abelian category has direct sums and products, computed termwise, products being computed on K-injective representatives (statement lines 2225-2236). The proof is a complete argument: the direct sum statement is verified against the description of morphisms in the derived category (proof lines 2238-2253), and the product statement is reduced to the product rule for K-injective complexes by resolving each object K-injectively (proof lines 2254-2259). The non-formal content is the verification of the two universal properties. The claim is H2.
